workload_work_year_days_001.evidence: The teacher duty year will be made up of 196 paid duty days, which include the six (6) paid holidays within the regular school year.

workload_workday_length_002.answer: No longer than 40 hours per week; no regularly scheduled duty day shall extend beyond 8 1/2 hours
workload_workday_length_002.evidence: The normal workweek of full-time teachers shall be no longer than 40 hours including their one-half hour daily duty-free lunch period. No regularly scheduled duty day shall extend beyond 8½ hours unless voted on by the licensed staff assigned to the particular site/program by a vote of 70%.

workload_prep_guarantee_003.evidence: All teachers/RSPs are entitled to a preparation time every day within the defined student day.

workload_prep_minutes_004.evidence: The amount of preparation time for elementary teachers shall be a minimum of 275 minutes per five-day work week.

workload_prep_protected_005.evidence: Any teacher/RSP required to attend meetings scheduled during their preparation time shall be paid at their direct instruction rate of pay or be provided an alternative preparation time by administration.

workload_lunch_duty_free_006.evidence: All teachers/RSPs are entitled to a preparation time and one-half hour daily duty-free lunch period every day within the defined student day.
